note: Lean pays the radius change through a ratio `r` split between hot and cold sites and an occupancy factor `μ`, and states the permission as `r ≤ exp(δB/(64μ))`; it does not name the cost `β̂_{i+1}^{|I|}` on a mode.

snippet.text:
theorem reset [Fintype V] (h : Spent ok A u δ κ b) (H : A.Active) {μ : ℕ} (hot : Finset V) {D r : ℝ} (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hh : Occupancy A.origins μ) (hB : 8 ≤ P.p.B) (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) (hu : ∀ v, 0 ≤ u v)
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (he : 0 ≤ δ) (hi : ∀ v∈hot, D*w v ≤ u v*r) (hc : ∀ v∉hot, D*w v ≤ u v/r)
    (hp : r ≤ Real.exp (δ*P.p.B/(64*μ)))
    (pack : ∀ i, ok i → let s := i.val; let y := (s∩hot).image A.origins
      s.Nonempty ∧ ((s∩hot).card ≤ (s\hot).card ∨
        2 ≤ y.card ∧ (↑y : Set (Site n)).Pairwise (fun x y => P.p.B^2 ≤ separation x y))) :
    Spent ok A w 0 κ (b/D) := by

proof_context.conclusion: A `Spent` budget survives replacing the weights `u` by `w` when the jump ratio satisfies `r ≤ exp (δ*B/(64*μ))`, the hot-site constraint and the pack condition (`B^2`-separated or hot-minority).

snippet.text:
theorem toll_reset [DecidableEq V] {u w : V → ℝ} {D r δ : ℝ} (hot s : Finset V)
    (hu : ∀ v∈s, 0≤u v) (hw : ∀ v∈s, 0≤w v) (hr : 1≤r) (hD : 1≤D)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hμ : 0<μ)
    (hi : ∀ v∈s ∩ hot,D*w v ≤ u v*r) (hc : ∀ v∈s\hot,D*w v ≤ u v/r)
    (hg : r ≤ Real.exp (δ*B/(64*μ))) (h : s.Nonempty)
    {X : Support n} (hs : (s∩hot).card ≤ (s\hot).card ∨ B*(s∩hot).card ≤ 64*coverNumber B X * μ) :
    D*(∏ i∈s, w i) ≤ (∏ i∈s, u i)* Real.exp (δ*coverNumber B X) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `D*∏ w ≤ (∏ u) * exp (δ*coverNumber B X)` once `r ≤ exp (δ*B/(64*μ))` and the hot sites satisfy the pack bound.
